data.name: Yume Nikki
data.detailed_description:
An RPG Maker tour de force, and a divisively controversial work for fans.


You are free to explore the various dream worlds at your own pace.
If you check certain characters or items in the game you will collect an “Effect”. These “Effects” can be used to change the main character’s appearance.

Some of these “Effects” have special actions or animations which you can activate by pressing 1 or 3 on the number pad.

Yume Nikki is a very unique title that has become one of the most well-known indie games to come out of Japan.

It is unlike any other RPG, especially in the fact that there really is no action or dialogue to speak of. This gives the game a very dark and foreboding atmosphere. Can you make it to the secret ending?

  • There are no particular goals nor story of which to speak. You simply walk around.
  • Checking certain characters inside the dream will increase the number of "Effects".
  • Using "Effects" will cause the main character's appearance to change.
  • (During this time, you can use the 1 or 3 keys to implement special movements and effects.)
  • Using the same "Effect" a second time will cause the character to revert to their original form.
  • "Effects" can only be discarded inside rooms with many doors.

FAQ

Q. There is a glitch or aspect ratio issue in the game.
A. Please switch to Window mode by pressing F4 or Alt + Enter.

Q. Why does the Japanese version crash?
A. The Japanese language coding in this game runs only on Japanese system locales. If you want to play the game in Japanese and it crashes, please change your system locale to Japanese.

  • Memória: 32 MB de RAM

reviews.review:
walking, we do a little walking
1. This is a game that's best played blind, or not at all, as it's very experience sensitive. In fact, some of the reviews you read here are already telling you too much about the game. Read this one instead.

2. Probably the worst game tutorial ever. It doesn't tell you anything a 6 year old couldn't figure out by mashing keys until something happens, setting you up to die of boredom and frustration later on. Keep reading and I'll explain.

So, because the game's tutorial is more useless than EA is with all the franchises and ips they bought, I'm taking over the job.

1. Some 'effects' have passive effects like, for example, moving through water faster. Some 'effects' can also be activated by pressing 1, 2, or z and do things like making you hop, or sit. Some of those activated effects require special conditions to happen.

2. You can drop your currently equipped effect in the Room of Doors by pressing 5. This is useful, but I won't say when and why.

3. The dream world logic is weird and nearly unpredictable. Don't underestimate the power of an umbrella, don't be afraid to try random ♥♥♥♥ just to see what happens, and don't fool yourself into thinking you got it figured out.

4. When you start getting tired of walking, get the bicycle. Open the purple door in the Room of Doors, the one farthest from the entrance, and look for it there. It's closeish.

이게임을 알면 그새끼는 슬슬틀딱이다
물론 나도 그렇다
만약 언더테일같은 느낌을 받으러왔다면 안하는게 좋다
걍 이거는 아무생각 없이하는거다
게임이라고 하기에도 무리수가있음 좋은 꿈 꾸러갑니다

　　　 "게임이기 보단, 예술적 작품"
단순히 게임이기 보단, 한 사람의 심리적•내적 상황을 여러 장면으로 상징화하여 그린 예술적인 작품.
잠깐 해봤는데 재밌음.
